These pathways highlight a recurring mechanism where drugs interact with Slc22a6 through their binding to the transporter, suggesting a potential role for Slc22a6 in the physiological effects of these compounds. The integration of these pathways implies that Acetaminophen may influence Slc22a6 through different routes, possibly by affecting the renal and prostatic systems, and that the transporter may be a common target in these processes.
